queries.label: Count samples with one-minute load at least 2
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM {{table}} WHERE load_1m >= 2.0

queries.label: Count samples for one system in a one-hour window
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM {{table}} WHERE system_id={{window_source}} AND elapsed_s >= {{window_start}} AND elapsed_s < {{window_end}}

queries.label: Count, average, minimum and maximum one-minute load
queries.sql: SELECT count(load_1m) AS n, avg(load_1m) AS average, min(load_1m) AS minimum, max(load_1m) AS maximum FROM {{table}}

queries.label: Average CPU and available memory per system
queries.sql: SELECT system_id, count(*) AS n, avg(cpu_user) AS cpu_user, avg(memory_available) AS memory_available FROM {{table}} GROUP BY system_id ORDER BY system_id

queries.label: Average fraction of memory unavailable for allocation
queries.sql: SELECT avg(1.0 - memory_available::DOUBLE / memory_total) AS fraction FROM {{table}} WHERE memory_total > 0

queries.label: Top five systems by average 15-minute load
queries.sql: SELECT system_id, avg(load_15m) AS average FROM {{table}} GROUP BY system_id ORDER BY average DESC NULLS LAST, system_id LIMIT 5

queries.label: Project the first 20 high-load samples
queries.sql: SELECT system_id, elapsed_s, load_1m, cpu_user FROM {{table}} WHERE load_1m >= 2.0 AND cpu_user > 0.1 ORDER BY system_id, elapsed_s, load_1m, cpu_user LIMIT 20
